notes: The «ح» splits two isnads of the same saying: two groups
In the second group «- ولا أعلمه إلا عن أبي بردة -» is a dashed remark that names Abu Burda as the link before Abu Musa: read as a link, not as a gloss; reviewer may decide
Ruling 11: after the matn, Aisha speaks and quotes the Prophet inside Abu Musa's account of his visit; whether she is a link after Abu Musa is not settled here, so she is not added
The second saying («قال اختلف في ذلك رهط») is part of the same report, not a separate isnad
